## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: sector breadth is tilted positive while leadership is mixed between Tech and Financials, producing no clear market direction.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Financials lead: SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +9.60%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.09% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND. Materials/Industrials also showing strength: APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND, GD (1W: +8.11% | 1M: +10.19%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities/Real Estate/Comm Services lag: CEG (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -9.40%) BELOW TREND, EQIX (1W: -5.74% | 1M: -6.08%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -5.58% | 1M: +6.95%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +16.14% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY; ACN (1W: +13.95% | 1M: -20.53%) RECOVERY; APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND; SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +10.76% | 1M: -7.23%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (Tech-heavy with Financial presence).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LRCX (1W: -20.63% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -20.17% | 1M: +10.52%) CORRECTION; INTC (1W: -16.19% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND; RCL (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND; CAT (1W: -9.01% | 1M: -0.04%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in semis/industrial bellwethers.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +16.14% | 1M: -5.17%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +13.95% | 1M: -20.53%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND — note major short-term reversals in several large-cap Tech names (MAJOR divergence risk).

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with short-term bounces. AAPL (1W: +10.26% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +5.50% | 1M: -9.16%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -9.94%) RECOVERY; ASML (1W: -7.21% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND. Sector showing internal rotation; many leaders are RECOVERY rather than ABOVE TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Clear relative strength. JPM (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +9.60%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.09% | 1M: +10.00%) ABOVE TREND — Financials are a confirmed leadership pocket within a neutral market.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive but mixed. JNJ (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +8.62%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -6.31%) BELOW TREND — sector positive overall but with stock-level dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and select Materials/Industrials exposure given ABOVE TREND readings (SCHW, JPM, APD, GD); reduce exposure to semiconductors and some mega-cap Tech on RECOVERY/volatility (NVDA, MSFT, AMAT). Style: Growth/Momentum tilt in short-term leadership but overall style mixed given breadth and divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: LRCX (1W: -20.63% | 1M: -2.99%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -16.19% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Financials (7/11 breadth positive context) — several names ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Semiconductors/Tech internals — notable individual weakness despite some rebounds.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch AAPL (1W: +10.26% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY for continuation above near-term resistance; NVDA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -9.94%) RECOVERY for failure to hold recent lift; SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND as confirmation of Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
SCHW (+65): Charles Schwab (SCHW) headline confirmed by price — SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. AAPL (+55): Apple chip deal headline vs price — AAPL (1W: +10.26% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY — bullish news partly confirmed but mixed with separate bearish headlines. XOM (+60): Exxon upbeat headline vs price — XOM (1W: +4.14% | 1M: -6.81%) RECOVERY — price rise confirms near-term sentiment but 1M remains negative.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-50): EU rules headline vs price divergence — AAPL (1W: +10.26% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY — distribution risk given conflicting headlines. ORCL (-50): downgrade noted; ORCL not in detailed dataset here but watch for follow-through in Tech. ADBE (-60): downgrade risk flagged; monitor Adobe relative moves (not in detailed time-series here).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt but style mixed across sectors. SCHW (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND and APD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated short-term tech rebounds (many RECOVERY cases) with conflicting news (AAPL/XOM headlines) — watch for trend confirmation or failure.
